title: Pulling Out Then
description:
Faced with a shady money scheme, {name} pulled out, saying 'this is dangerous.'

That decision comes back sometimes.

Today a fast but risky road appears again.

choices.text: Pulling out then — was the best thing I did
choices.result_text:
Fast money usually invites a faster fall.

Because they pulled out then, {name} stayed on a clean path.
Not doing what shouldn't be done was a clear choice too.

choices.text: Even now — filter out the dangerous
choices.result_text:
One who's pulled out once knows how to pull out again.

{name} still uses that sense for reading danger signals.
Not crossing the line was a condition for going far.

title: Crossing the Line Then
description:
At some early point, {name} crossed a line they shouldn't have, telling themselves 'just once.'

The weight of that choice comes back sometimes.

Today they stand before a similar gray zone.

choices.text: I learned then — 'just once' is the most dangerous phrase
choices.result_text:
'Just once' was a spell that summoned the second time.

{name} remembers the unease of crossing that line.
They decided never to fool themselves with those words again.

choices.text: Repay that debt — the clean way
choices.result_text:
A line once crossed can't be undone, but the life after can be lived differently.

{name} decided to fill that choice with honest effort.
The past can't be erased, but the direction can change.

title: Going In Within My Means
description:
Facing an investment offer, {name} didn't overreach and went in 'within my means.'

That right-sized choice comes back sometimes.

Today there's the temptation of a big bet.

choices.text: Only what I can bear — that's how you last
choices.result_text:
Investing beyond your means collapses at one swing.

Because {name} moved within what they could handle, they held to the end.
Knowing your limits was, in the end, skill too.

choices.text: Now — that range of means has widened
choices.result_text:
Started with small money then, but the range has grown.

{name} always invested within means — but grew those means.
Growing without overreaching was the sturdiest path.

title: Asking Again, with What I'd Learned
description:
At the spot where they were once humiliated, {name} asked again 'properly this time,' with what they'd learned.

That moment of redemption comes back sometimes.

Today they face an area that was once a weakness.

choices.text: Repaid the humiliation — with growth
choices.result_text:
That embarrassing moment made them grit their teeth and learn.

{name} turned a former weakness into a strength.
Humiliation wasn't the end, but a chance to learn properly.

choices.text: Now — I'm not ashamed of not knowing
choices.result_text:
Hiding what you don't know is more dangerous than being embarrassed by it.

{name} learned asking isn't shameful.
That one redemption changed their attitude toward learning.

title: Still Embarrassed
description:
At the spot where they were once humiliated, {name} still bowed their head and avoided it, embarrassed.

That shame comes back sometimes.

Today came a moment of facing that area again.

choices.text: Now — I move past that shame
choices.result_text:
Only avoiding it leaves that spot a permanent weakness.

{name} decided to lift their head and face it this time.
Shame only vanishes when faced.

choices.text: Accept that embarrassment too — as part of me
choices.result_text:
Imperfect moments are part of what made me too.

{name} decided not to erase the embarrassment, but to carry it.
Having embarrassing memories also meant having tried that much.

title: Leaving Awkwardly
description:
{name} once left an awkward situation uncomfortably.

That moment of avoidance comes back sometimes.

Today they face an uncomfortable situation again.

choices.text: Now — I hold my ground even when uncomfortable
choices.result_text:
Flee every awkward thing and the chance to toughen up vanishes too.

{name} slowly built the strength to endure discomfort.
Just staying instead of fleeing made some situations familiar.

choices.text: Sometimes avoiding is better — I discern
choices.result_text:
No need to endure every discomfort.

{name} learned to tell which to weather and which to leave.
Avoidance wasn't always weakness — sometimes it was a wise choice.

title: Brushing Off Hyun-su's Warning
description:
When Hyun-su warned to be careful of Jae-hyuk, {name} trusted the army buddy — 'Jae-hyuk wouldn't.'

That ignored warning comes back sometimes.

Today another's warning clashes with my trust again.

choices.text: Should've listened then — now I don't brush off warnings
choices.result_text:
A close person's warning usually has a reason.

{name} learned expensively to tell what they wish were true from what is.
Trust is precious, but blind faith was dangerous.

choices.text: Trusting a person — I don't regret
choices.result_text:
Even if the result was bad, the heart that tried to trust a friend wasn't wrong.

{name} didn't want a life lived only in suspicion.
But they learned trust needs eyes too.

title: Saying I'll Just Take the Thought
description:
When the goshiwon owner offered a job, {name} declined — 'I'll just take the thought, I'm looking for something better.'

That pride — or stubbornness — comes back sometimes.

Today they stand at a similar fork of kindness.

choices.text: Declining then — led to a better path
choices.result_text:
Had they settled into the immediate offer, they'd have stopped there.

{name} kept the stubbornness of seeking something better.
Sometimes declining a good offer was a choice for something bigger.

choices.text: You must know how to accept help too — I know now
choices.result_text:
Declining every kindness out of pride is foolish sometimes.

{name} also learned the flexibility to accept help worth accepting.
The stubbornness to do everything alone wasn't always right.

title: Thinking It Wasn't Enough Yet
description:
Checking assets at a mid-point, {name} didn't grow complacent — 'this is nothing, still far to go.'

That hunger comes back sometimes.

Today they stand before a small achievement.

choices.text: That hunger — kept complacency away
choices.result_text:
Get drunk on small wins and you stop there.

{name} always went further with an 'not yet' mindset.
The hunger of deferring satisfaction ultimately made the distance.

choices.text: Now — balance hunger with self-acknowledgment
choices.result_text:
Keep saying it's never enough and even arriving brings no satisfaction.

{name} decided to go further while also acknowledging the self that came this far.
Hunger and self-flagellation were different.

title: She's at the End of This Road Too, I Said
description:
Near the end, {name} confirmed a future with Dae-un — 'we're still together; she's at the end of this road too.'

That resolve comes back sometimes.

Today they think about the road with Dae-un.

choices.text: Because she's there — this road wasn't lonely
choices.result_text:
A road walked alone and one with someone waiting at the end are different.

To {name}, Dae-un wasn't the goal but part of the reason.
Having someone to smile with on arrival was a great strength.

choices.text: Not for her sake — but to be together, I go
choices.result_text:
Not a life for someone, but a life together.

{name} saw Dae-un as a companion, not a burden.
Love wasn't a substitute for the goal, but walking the goal together.

title: Talking to the Manager Privately
description:
When someone took credit for {name}'s work, {name} talked to the manager privately.

That moment of speaking up comes back sometimes.

Today, before another injustice, that day came to mind.

choices.text: Speaking up then — protected me
choices.result_text:
Only endure, and the credit-thief alone wins.

{name} learned to justly claim their own share.
Speaking up and fighting were different — it was self-respect.

choices.text: Refine the manner — but don't stay silent
choices.result_text:
Speak up, but how you do it matters too.

{name} refined arguing by fact, not emotion.
They learned to not stay silent at injustice while not making enemies.

title: Meeting the Headhunter
description:
At a headhunter's contact, {name} explored a job change — 'I'll meet once.'

That exploration comes back sometimes.

Today they stand at a career fork again.

choices.text: Widening options — became leverage
choices.result_text:
Just knowing another path exists creates leverage.

Even without moving, {name} learned their market value.
One with options stood tall even when staying.

choices.text: Also re-saw — the value of my current place
choices.result_text:
You have to look outside to see the value within.

Exploring a move, {name} rediscovered the merits of the present.
Whether to leave or stay could only be decided properly after comparing.

title: Checking My Market Value
description:
To the headhunter, {name} just gathered info — 'tell me more about the terms' — to check their market value.

That check comes back sometimes.

Today they gauge their own position again.

choices.text: Knowing my value — is the start of all negotiation
choices.result_text:
Not knowing your market value, you can't get your worth.

{name} built the habit of regularly checking their position.
Only one holding the information negotiated unshaken.

choices.text: Find ways — to raise that value further
choices.result_text:
After knowing the current value, {name} didn't stop there.

They reverse-engineered what to add to raise it.
Self-worth wasn't given, but built.

title: Asking About the Growth Path
description:
At the year-end review, {name} asked first 'what to improve for an S grade next year.'

That initiative comes back sometimes.

Today they ponder the direction of growth.

choices.text: Asking first — sped up my growth
choices.result_text:
One who waits for the review and one who asks the direction first are different.

{name} sought feedback first without fearing it.
Growth came faster to those who asked.

choices.text: Now — I watch growth both inside and outside the company
choices.result_text:
A company grade isn't the only growth.

{name} designed company advancement and personal goals together.
An S grade is good, but the real goal lay beyond it.
